notes.title: Not dead. Not ready.
notes.content:
But I have health problems that I plan to solve in the near future.
UPD: solved.
But there are some good news
Current state:

+ new frontend engine (better graphic etc)
+ good lore
+ nice monsters
+ nice dungeons
+ nice secret rooms system (they will be everywhere)

Entire game will be much more intresting than current demo.
Random and static dungeons, secret rooms, nice bosses and skill-requiring gameplay.


But (hah) bad news too
- because of my health problems there is VERY small progress
- again more time for demo. Its was planned 12.12.2019, but always but.
